propositions: Replace per-criterion fan-out with batched successor runs over unbanked remainder criteria, recording verified criteria incrementally to a run-scoped bank and resuming recovery from banked progress on primary failure.

Criteria-scaled primary step floor verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c, 48, 480) reduces runaway trips by matching budget to actual need (~100 tool calls for typical multi-criterion tickets), eliminating the flat 480-step surplus that triggers exhaustion.
Path-normalized read_file memo caching collapses 77% re-read waste by caching whole-file content once per path and serving all line-range slices from cache within a run.

Request budget pool = multiplier × ceil(floor/2) per criteria count, allocated across sequential batched runs with batch-aware no-launch floor B >= 2×batch_size and batch-shrink re-planning to prevent doomed sub-threshold runs.

Finalizer emits full-coverage verdict (banked criteria scored from evidence, unverked as met=false placeholders) on any banked progress; deterministic no-LLM fallback closes verdict-less trap by building verdict directly from bank if LLM finalizer fails twice.
